+import json
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import unittest
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+
+
+class CountCliTest(unittest.TestCase):
+    def run_count(self, *args):
+        return subprocess.run(
+            [sys.executable, "count.py", *args],
+            cwd=ROOT,
+            capture_output=True,
+            text=True,
+            check=False,
+        )
+
+    def test_default_output(self):
+        result = self.run_count()
+
+        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0)
+        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, "0 widgets\n")
+        self.assertEqual(result.stderr, "")
+
+    def test_signed_integer_output(self):
+        for arg, expected in (("5", "5 widgets\n"), ("-3", "-3 widgets\n"), ("0", "0 widgets\n")):
+            with self.subTest(arg=arg):
+                result = self.run_count(arg)
+
+                self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0)
+                self.assertEqual(result.stdout, expected)
+                self.assertEqual(result.stderr, "")
+
+    def test_json_output(self):
+        for args, expected in (
+            ((), {"widgets": 0}),
+            (("7", "--json"), {"widgets": 7}),
+            (("--json", "-2"), {"widgets": -2}),
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(args=args):
+                result = self.run_count(*args, "--json") if not args else self.run_count(*args)
+
+                self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0)
+                self.assertEqual(json.loads(result.stdout), expected)
+                self.assertEqual(result.stderr, "")
+
+    def test_invalid_integer_argument(self):
+        result = self.run_count("abc")
+
+        self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)
+        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, "")
+        self.assertIn("invalid integer", result.stderr)
+        self.assertNotIn("Traceback", result.stderr)
+
+    def test_extra_or_unrecognized_arguments(self):
+        for args in (("1", "2"), ("--bogus",), ("--json", "--json")):
+            with self.subTest(args=args):
+                result = self.run_count(*args)
+
+                self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)
+                self.assertEqual(result.stdout, "")
+                self.assertIn("unexpected argument", result.stderr)
+                self.assertNotIn("Traceback", result.stderr)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+

+        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, "0 widgets\n")

+

+

+                self.assertEqual(result.stderr, "")

+
